prompt: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal time periods to highlight location- and season-specific buying behavior.
title: Co-Purchase Bundle Analysis
summary: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal periods to reveal location- and season-specific buying behavior.
executed_sql_queries: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS eligible_order_count, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM retail.orders o JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) ORDER BY order_year;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 'Winter'
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring'
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer'
      ELSE 'Fall'
    END AS season
  FROM retail.orders o
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026
), seasonal_order_counts AS (
  SELECT order_year, season, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM eligible_orders
  GROUP BY order_year, season
), seasonal_item_counts AS (
  SELECT eo.order_year, eo.season, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, COUNT(DISTINCT eo.order_id) AS orders_with_items
  FROM eligible_orders eo
  JOIN retail.order_items oi ON eo.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY eo.order_year, eo.season
)
SELECT
  soc.order_year,
  soc.season,
  soc.order_count,
  sic.orders_with_items,
  sic.line_item_count
FROM seasonal_order_counts soc
JOIN seasonal_item_counts sic
  ON soc.order_year = sic.order_year
 AND soc.season = sic.season
ORDER BY soc.order_year, soc.season;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    s.store_name,
    o.order_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter'
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring'
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer'
      ELSE 'Fall'
    END AS season
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
), order_item_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    eo.order_id,
    eo.store_name,
    eo.order_year,
    eo.season,
    oi.product_id,
    p.product_name
  FROM eligible_orders eo
  JOIN retail.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = eo.order_id
  JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
), order_level_counts AS (
  SELECT
    store_name,
    season,
    order_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_product_count
  FROM order_item_products
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    a.store_name,
    a.season,
    a.order_year,
    a.order_id,
    LEAST(a.product_name, b.product_name) AS product_name_1,
    GREATEST(a.product_name, b.product_name) AS product_name_2
  FROM order_item_products a
  JOIN order_item_products b
    ON a.order_id = b.order_id
   AND a.store_name = b.store_name
   AND a.season = b.season
   AND a.order_year = b.order_year
   AND a.product_id < b.product_id
), pair_agg AS (
  SELECT
    store_name,
    season,
    order_year,
    product_name_1,
    product_name_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY store_name, season, order_year
      ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2
    ) AS bundle_rank
  FROM pair_counts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
), top_pair AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM pair_agg
  WHERE bundle_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  olc.store_name,
  olc.season,
  olc.order_year,
  olc.order_count,
  olc.distinct_product_count,
  tp.product_name_1,
  tp.product_name_2,
  tp.co_purchase_frequency,
  ROUND(tp.co_purchase_frequency::numeric / NULLIF(olc.order_count,0), 4) AS co_purchase_share_of_orders,
  tp.bundle_rank
FROM order_level_counts olc
LEFT JOIN top_pair tp
  ON tp.store_name = olc.store_name
 AND tp.season = olc.season
 AND tp.order_year = olc.order_year
ORDER BY olc.store_name, olc.order_year, olc.season;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         s.store_name,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
         CASE
           WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter'
           WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring'
           WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer'
           ELSE 'Fall'
         END AS season
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
), order_level AS (
  SELECT eo.store_name, eo.order_year, eo.season, eo.order_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_product_count
  FROM eligible_orders eo
  JOIN retail.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = eo.order_id
  GROUP BY eo.store_name, eo.order_year, eo.season, eo.order_id
), summary AS (
  SELECT store_name, order_year, season,
         COUNT(*) AS order_count,
         ROUND(AVG(distinct_product_count)::numeric, 2) AS distinct_product_count
  FROM order_level
  GROUP BY store_name, order_year, season
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT eo.store_name, eo.order_year, eo.season,
         p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
         p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
         COUNT(DISTINCT eo.order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency,
         COUNT(DISTINCT eo.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(s.order_count, 0) AS co_purchase_share_of_orders,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY eo.store_name, eo.order_year, eo.season
           ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT eo.order_id) DESC, p1.product_name, p2.product_name
         ) AS bundle_rank
  FROM eligible_orders eo
  JOIN retail.order_items a ON a.order_id = eo.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items b ON b.order_id = eo.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = a.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = b.product_id
  JOIN summary s ON s.store_name = eo.store_name AND s.order_year = eo.order_year AND s.season = eo.season
  GROUP BY eo.store_name, eo.order_year, eo.season, p1.product_name, p2.product_name, s.order_count
), top_bundle AS (
  SELECT * FROM pair_counts WHERE bundle_rank = 1
)
SELECT s.store_name, s.season, s.order_year, s.order_count, s.distinct_product_count,
       tb.product_name_1, tb.product_name_2, tb.co_purchase_frequency,
       ROUND(tb.co_purchase_share_of_orders, 4) AS co_purchase_share_of_orders,
       tb.bundle_rank
FROM summary s
LEFT JOIN top_bundle tb
  ON tb.store_name = s.store_name AND tb.order_year = s.order_year AND tb.season = s.season
ORDER BY s.store_name, s.order_year, s.season;
